title: Prague Metro D, Prague and Brno connect delivery stages with municipal services
summary: One staged railway and two municipal accounts distinguish systems-scope conflicts, treatment periods, service access, heat trials and flood preparation. Eligibility reaches 96 projects and 67 places, not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Nineteen official sources inspected November 22: eighteen HTML bodies or scoped segments and one indexed municipal housing record after timeout; eighteen Czech and one English. Contract scope, forecasts, renamed stations, reported trial results and municipal access remain distinct. Stations, districts and component works add no extra identities.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
